titles.title: I Shouldn't Have Slept With You

description:
“Was sleeping with me... a mistake?”
Ji-wan, a college student returning after military service, ends up having an impulsive one-night stand with Seo-ah, a woman eight years his senior whom he met while out drinking. With her neat face and glasses, she seemed like a flawless professional. But in bed…

She became a completely different woman.

Ji-wan is completely captivated by her, but he's left with one question:
We slept together, so why is she acting like nothing happened?
To top it off, it turns out Seo-ah lives right next door. As the two keep bumping into each other, their dangerous nights repeat.
The more they meet, the more Ji-wan falls for her body and soul, but Seo-ah just seems to think of him as a cute younger guy...
And to top it all off, an older rival appears, thirsting after Seo-ah!
It started as a one-night stand, but one night is no longer enough for Ji-wan.
“Can't you see me as a man by now?”
A thrilling and cheeky 19+ role-reversal romcom between an older woman and a younger man, starting with the body and ending up capturing the heart!

[Original Webtoon](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/shouldnt_have_slept)
